scope: Full12statements/reference proofs/rubrics and edgecases, including pruning and robust cleaning; independent of author.
hash_algorithm: SHA256(UTF8(json.dumps({k:problem[k] for k in [title,statement,criterions,reference_solution]}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))); Python default separators comma-space and colon-space, no newline.
